title: The Summer I Turned Pretty Makers Warn Fans To 'Act Normal', Know Why | Hollywood News - News18
text: The Summer I Turned Pretty Season 3, starring Lola Tung, Christopher Briney, and Gavin Casalegno, is heading toward its finale on September 17. The romantic drama has won over audiences with its relatable themes of growing up, love, and nostalgia, earning massive viewership. However, not all fans are pleased with the current storyline, and some have taken their disappointment way too far. Ahead of the Season 3 Episode 8 premiere, the makers took to social media to express their disappointment over fans bullying the cast and even issuing death threats to one of the lead actors. Prime Video’s Official Statement According to Variety, Prime Video issued a statement addressing the show’s audience, expressing disappointment over the recent wave of online bullying directed at The Summer I Turned Pretty cast members. Taking to X, the makers dropped a post featuring a video graphic note that reads, “The Summer we started acting normal online." The caption reads, “The show isn’t real, but the people playing the characters are." The Summer I Turned Pretty Cast Death Threats The warning followed a wave of online insults targeting several stars, along with public death threats against Gavin Casalegno, who plays Jeremiah Fisher, one of the two brothers, alongside Conrad (Christopher Briney), competing for Belly Conklin’s affections throughout the three seasons, Variety reported. According to production sources, the warning on Tuesday came as the show neared its finale and viewers grew more vocal. Producers noted that with each weekly release, the risk of toxic online behaviour has increased, fueled by users hiding behind anonymity to post harsh remarks. Variety further reported that, beyond targeting Gavin Casalegno for his role as Belly’s love interest, Jeremiah, some fans have also gone after him over his alleged conservative political views, citing social media posts he has liked. The Summer I Turned Pretty: Plot According to USA Today, The Summer I Turned Pretty is based on author Jenny Han’s popular novel trilogy of the same name, which chronicles first love, first heartbreak, and the magic of one perfect summer. The show’s third and final season follows Belly as she navigates her first love, heartbreak, and life-altering decisions.
